# dsh-local-font-picker
English | 日本語
A community plugin for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web UI that lets you choose installed local fonts
for the interface and code surfaces.
> This is a community-maintained plugin, not part of the DeepSeek Harness core distribution.
## What it does

- Lists locally installed fonts through the Local Font Access API (`window.queryLocalFonts()`).
- Ap
plies the selected UI and code fonts through the built-in DSH Theme API (`ctx.theme.setFontFamily(ro

le, value)`); persistence, CSS application, and reload restore belong to the DSH core settings.
- Ke
eps no settings of its own — no `localStorage`, no Theme token overrides. The built-in font settings

and this plugin row always read and write the same core state.
- Falls back to manual font-name ent

ry when the Local Font Access API is unavailable.
- Requires no changes to the DSH source tree and n
o plugin build step.
The host entry (`index.js`) is intentionally a no-op. All behavior runs in the Web client.
## Compatibility
Since **0.3.0** this plugin delegates font state to the DSH core (`ctx.theme.setFontFamily`); it sto
res nothing of its own. Earlier plugin releases kept their own copy in `localStorage` plus Theme tok
en overrides. The table records runtime verification per listed state; rows up to 0.2.1-alpha.1 were
recorded on the pre-0.3.0 mechanism.
Latest DSH version with recorded runtime verification of the settings row and font apply: **0.2.2-al
pha.2**, runtime-verified against the live app on 2026-10-29; the previous lane **0.2.1-rc.2** was r
untime-verified on 2026-10-17. **0.2.2-rc.1** is covered by the declared range and its load path is

## Usage
Open **Settings → General → Fonts**.

- Use **Load PC fonts** to request access to the browser's local font list.
- Select or type an inst
alled font family for the UI font and code font; the value is written to the DSH built-in font setti

ngs and stays in sync with the built-in font rows.
- Use **Reset to default** to hand both roles bac
k to the built-in font list.
Button and status labels follow the copy language described above: the English list shows **Load PC
fonts**, Japanese shows **PCフォントを読み込む**, and the same applies to the rest of the row.
Copy language follows the browser's preferred languages, not the DSH Language setting. The first usa
ble preference decides: `ja` renders Japanese, anything else renders English.
## Privacy and permissions
Using **Load PC fonts** invokes the browser Local Font Access API and may show a permission prompt.
The browser can expose installed font metadata to this page after permission is granted.
This plugin:
stores no settings of its own — selected font family names are persisted by the DSH core settings,
not by plugin-managed `localStorage`.
## Limitations
- Local Font Access is primarily available in Chromium-based desktop browsers. Other browsers can st

ill use manual font-name entry.
- Font settings live in the DSH core settings and are shared with th

e built-in font rows; this plugin adds no separate storage.
- Requires DSH **0.2.1-alpha.2** or newe

r — the core font-family settings the plugin delegates to were added there.
- DSH is still evolving

rapidly, so client extension contracts can change between prerelease versions.
- The copy language i
s decided once when the row module loads. Changing the browser's preferred languages takes effect on
the next page reload.
